verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਰਜ ਗੁਣੁ ਤਮ ਗੁਣੁ ਸਤ ਗੁਣੁ ਜਿਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: paun paanee baisa(n)taro raj gun tam gun sat gun jitaa|

en.bdb: Air, water, fire and the three qualities – tranquillity, activity and inertness have been conquered by the Sikh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਸੰਕਲਪ ਕਰਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗੋਇ ਦੁਚਿਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: man bach karam sa(n)kalap kar ik man hoi vigoi dhuchitaa|

en.bdb: With the concentration of mind, speech, action and meditating upon the One, he has lost the sense of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: lok vedh gur giaan liv a(n)dhar ik baahar bahu bhitaa|

en.bdb: Absorption in the knowledge of the Guru is his conduct in the world. In his innerself he is One (with the Lord) while he performs diverse duties in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਜਿਣਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਥਿਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: maat lok paataal jin surag lok vich hoi athitaa|

en.bdb: Conquering the earth and the nether world he establishes himself in heavens.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhe kar patit pavitaa|

en.bdb: By speaking sweetly, behaving humbly and bestowing charities with one's own hands, even the fallen ones have become pure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਡੋਲ ਅਮੋਲ ਅਮਿਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal paiaa atul addol amol amitaa|

en.bdb: Thus, the gurmukh attains incomparable and invalauable fruits of delight.
Associating with the holy congregation he squeezes out the ego (from the mind).
